title: Cheesy Skillet Delight
description: A simple yet indulgent skillet dish loaded with cheddar cheese, perfect for a cozy evening. Serve hot and enjoy!

ingredients.name: Skillet
ingredients.notes: Pre-heated oven or a non-stick pan

instructions: In a pre-heated skillet, melt 1 tbsp of butter over low heat.
Add 2 tsp of Eastern Spice Blend and stir for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of cheddar cheese and 1/2 cup of mozzarella cheese. Stir until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Transfer the skillet to the pre-heated oven and bake for 5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
